name: claude-code-agent
description: Run Anthropic's Claude Code as an agent (acp:claude-code) via the Zed ACP adapter. It runs with a Claude config of its own that starts empty, and loads nothing from the folder it works in (no .claude settings, .mcp.json servers, CLAUDE.md or skills), so no auto-approve rule of yours or of a repository's comes along: apart from the file reads and read-only commands Claude Code allows itself, every tool asks through PersonalClaw's approval gate. Sign in to Claude once for it (Settings → Providers → Claude Code → Sign in); PersonalClaw stores no key. Turn off Isolated Claude settings to use your own ~/.claude, rules included, and the Claude settings of the folder it works in. Enabling it installs its ACP adapter (@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp) from npm into your PersonalClaw home when no copy is installed; a failed install says why on its card, with Retry.
author: PersonalClaw

launches.why: Claude Code does the work of each chat. Its ACP adapter starts it and hands it each turn.

writes.why: The Claude config Claude Code runs with while Isolated Claude settings is on. It starts empty, and signing in to Claude for this app keeps that sign-in there.

x-meta.label: Isolated Claude settings
x-meta.help: On: Claude runs with a config of its own under PersonalClaw's folder that starts empty, and loads nothing from the folder it works in (its .claude settings, .mcp.json servers, CLAUDE.md and skills), so no auto-approve rule of yours or of a repository's comes along: apart from the file reads and read-only commands Claude Code allows itself, every tool asks here first. Sign in to Claude once for it. Off: Claude uses your own ~/.claude, auto-approve rules included, and the folder's own Claude settings, whose rules, hooks and MCP servers apply without asking here first.

x-meta.label: Default Model
x-meta.help: Optional. Leave empty to use the Claude CLI's own current default (recommended). The Claude adapter advertises the live model set for selection; set this only to pin a specific model.

x-meta.label: ACP Adapter Path
x-meta.help: Optional absolute path to the claude-agent-acp adapter. Empty finds it: PATH → node-manager dirs → the copy PersonalClaw installed in its home when you enabled the app → npx @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp. Equivalent to the CLAUDE_CODE_ACP_BIN env var.
